name: Hair loss remedies and hair recovery
what_it_is: Videos about hair fall and how to treat it: promotions and testimonials for biotin IV drips, onion shampoo, herbal soap, rosemary serum/tonic, and scalp-washing advice, plus one long-to-short "hair transition" haircut after heavy shedding. They share the subject of hair loss and recovery rather than one triggering event.
